title: I made Aetherfall by describing it to an AI
author: alex7550
selftext:
Aetherfall is a game I built in Tesana. I described what I wanted in plain words, and the AI wrote the code and made the art. Then I played it and asked for changes until it felt right.

It's free in your browser, no download. Happy to answer questions about how the AI handled it.

Play it free in your browser: https://tesana.com/game/aetherfall-aeyon

comments.author: vriemeister
comments.body: Your orc is juggling invisible balls as he runs and has a sword sticking through his wrist. This needs a little more polish.

replies.author: alex7550
replies.body: Yes I agree, I am still at the start of it and it needs  indeed much more polish, but I ran out of credits so I am waiting next month to refill and continue.

replies.author: alex7550

Currently working on some quests and a better tutorial. Thank you for trying my game
